text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Tenno Sho approaching in<n>the spring, Rice
Shower intensifies her<n>training so she can become
a blue<n>rose for more and more people.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems she's also<n>worried about
disappointing those<n>who are helping her reach that
goal.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy argues that the blue<n>rose in the
story was unable to bloom<n>by itself, so Rice Shower
should also<n>reach out for help when she needs it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her words hit hard, and Rice Shower<n>decides that
she does, in fact, need<n>help.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She asks Mihono Bourbon to assist<n>with her
training, and Bourbon agrees.<n>Thus begins
Bourbon's rumored<n>"demonic" training regimen.
